name: flow
description: The shared engineering workflow for every repository: /flow:lfg (issue to merge-ready PR), /flow:follow-through (epic to merged, unattended), /flow:finish-prs, /flow:plan (incl. upstream library fixes carried to a release), /flow:github-review-pr|failures|comments, /flow:tdd, /flow:review-pr, /flow:debug-flaky, and the flow:fable-validator agent. Repository facts come from the `## Workflow` section of each repo's AGENTS.md. No hooks, no gates, no memory layer.
